questions.q: Who are the sons of God in Genesis 6:2?
choices: The lineage of Adam laid out in chapter 5
questions.explain: The sons of God are the lineage of Adam; the daughters of men were of the other nations.

questions.q: What law does Genesis 6:1-2 show was known from the beginning?
choices: The law against marrying into the other nations
questions.explain: Moses had to reiterate that same law to the children of Israel (Deuteronomy 7:3).

questions.q: How long did the Most High shorten man's lifespan to in Genesis 6:3?
questions.explain: In chapter 5 the forefathers lived seven, eight and nine hundred years.

questions.q: Who are the angels which kept not their first estate (Jude 1:6)?
choices: Men from the lineage of Adam whose first estate was sons of God
questions.explain: Another word for angel is messenger; they came from the lineage of Adam and mixed with the other nations.

questions.q: Why did it take faith for Noah to build the ark?
choices: Rain had never been seen until then
The ark was too big to float
Gopher wood could not be found
questions.explain: Faith is the evidence of things not seen; with Noah the thing not seen was rain (Hebrews 11:1, 7).
